grammar.summary: 本课学习表"创作自由"的 free from 与 cut off from。

points.title: free from/of 表"免于"
points.explanation: He wants to be free from criticism. free from + 名词 = 不受……影响。

examples.en: Writers want to be free from editorial interference.
examples.cn: 作家希望不受编辑干预。

points.title: cut off from 表"与……隔绝"
points.explanation: cut off from the masses = 与大众隔绝。过去分词短语作表语/定语。

examples.en: He was cut off from his readers.
